market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $85 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI dropped 9% on May 6 to below $93 on US-Iran de-escalation news. Current price ~$93-100. Reaching $85 requires further -10% drop. With negotiations potentially yielding a deal that lifts Iran sanctions (adding ~1-2 mbd supply), $85 is plausible. May low so far is around $93.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Pace and depth of Iran sanctions relief and OPEC+ response
